# Vendored: Hindsight memory engine

This directory is an unmodified copy of the `hindsight-api-slim` Python package
from [Hindsight](https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight) (MIT, Copyright (c)
2025 Vectorize AI, Inc. — see `LICENSE`), taken from the
[vaishnavjai/hindsight](https://github.com/vaishnavjai/hindsight) fork.

| | |
|---|---|
| Upstream path | `hindsight-api-slim/` (`hindsight_api/`, `pyproject.toml`, `README.md`) and the root `LICENSE` |
| Upstream commit | `ccfe85b4851957ac2adf88b4a9ddf9668b2882f1` |
| Package version | `hindsight-api-slim` 0.10.1 |
| Not vendored | the upstream test suite, docs, clients and integrations |

Harness-specific files (not from upstream):

- `requirements.lock.txt` — every runtime dependency (the `embedded-db` extra,
  no local ML models) pinned with SHA-256 hashes for all platforms. Generated by
  `uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra embedded-db --generate-hashes --universal --python-version 3.11`.
- `VENDORED.md` — this file.

Harness never edits the engine's source. Its safety rails (loopback-only
binding, per-launch API token, egress allowlist, orphan guard, no `.env`
discovery, pinned data directory) live in
`packages/memory/python/harness_hindsight_launcher.py`, which runs the engine.

## Updating

```bash
# from a checkout of the Hindsight fork at the commit you want
rsync -a --delete --exclude __pycache__ hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/ <harness>/vendor/hindsight/hindsight_api/
cp hindsight-api-slim/pyproject.toml hindsight-api-slim/README.md <harness>/vendor/hindsight/
cp LICENSE <harness>/vendor/hindsight/LICENSE

cd <harness>/vendor/hindsight
uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra embedded-db --generate-hashes --universal \
  --python-version 3.11 --no-header -o requirements.lock.txt
```

Then update the commit above, rebuild the runtime
(`node scripts/hindsight/prepare-runtime.mjs --outdir .hindsight-runtime`) and run
`cd packages/memory && bun test src test/e2e`.
